name: Kiyosato Kouichirou
source:
The director of Kiyosato Hospital, and [url=http://vndb.org/c1669]Misako[/url]'s father. He hasn't yet retired from practicing medicine, but the truth is he really doesn't work anymore. His favorite pastime is chatting with his granddaughter, [url=http://vndb.org/c1675]Yui[/url].
